posts.title: Renovate for KDE
posts.description: Renovate is a helpful tool that updates your dependencies automatically. This is cool, because it means you don’t have to track updates to your dependencies manually, which let’s be honest never really work. Renovate will just create a new merge request as soon as it detects an update. This is particularly relevant now, with more and more vulnerabilities being detected in our software supply chain
